note: Crafts of the Gearlands/Numinous Reach (mechanical_spiritual axis) — the axis whose deep peak is What Sleeps Under. Enginecraft is the mechanical-pole tradition (Precursor arts at their most technical); Numenwork the spiritual-pole (the mystic disciplines the framework keeps converging toward). Learned by traveling the Reach or training with Enginewrights/the Numinous. Both drift the wielder toward their pole; the doubly-charged Forge of Ends is where they meet. Distinct from precursor.json: Precursor is the Valley's dangerous folk-access to the deep; these are the Reach's true traditions. axes signed for engine compat. Authored by Aevi (PO), SNG-016.

abilities.notFor: The numinous/meaning side of a Precursor site (that's Numenwork); life or growth; anything that must be felt rather than built.

tree.cannot: The system does what its mechanism allows, not what you wish; the numinous layer stays opaque — you move the body, not the meaning.

abilities.name: Self-Mending Work
abilities.narrationHints: You build the repair INTO the thing — so that when it breaks, and it will, it knows how to find its own way back to whole without you.

abilities.notFor: It makes durable things, not living ones — a self-mending work is still a work, patient and unfeeling. And building the mending in costs far more than building the thing; you pay the whole future's repairs up front.

tree.name: Self-Mending Work

tree.cannot: It cannot mend the living, only the made; it costs the future's repairs at the moment of making; and a thing built to outlast you will — with all the grief that carries.

tree.name: Work That Learns

tree.cannot: A work that improves itself drifts from its maker's intent, and the Enginewrights argue whether that is mastery or abandonment. It still cannot mend the living. abilities.name: Thinned Veil
abilities.narrationHints: You thin the veil to a membrane where they are standing — and something on the other side, which has been waiting a very long time, gets a claw through. Then a tooth. Then more of itself. The wounds are real, wet, and shaped wrong.
abilities.description: Thin the veil to a membrane where a target is standing until something reaches through — a claw opens them shoulder to hip, a mouth takes a hand, acid comes through and does not stop eating. The Numinous first offense, and NOT the common one: most of the tradition works meaning, these few turn the same attention outward and find the actual membrane.
abilities.notFor: Control (you open the way; you do NOT direct what comes through, and it will take whoever is nearest); subtlety (every numen-sense for a mile feels this); closing it quickly once something is committed to the opening.

abilities.name: Seized Works
abilities.narrationHints: You do not stop the mechanism. You stop it AT LOAD — the drawn cord at release, the turning axle at speed, the pressure-vessel at full — and a made thing under strain that is suddenly told not to move puts all of it somewhere. Usually into the hand holding it.
abilities.description: Seize a worked mechanism at the moment of maximum strain — the crossbow's limbs come apart into the shooter's face, the buckle binds and the strap crushes, the winch's pawl snaps. The Enginewrights' first offense: force that cannot go where it was going goes into whoever is nearest.
abilities.notFor: Anything unmade (a fist, a stone, a beast — nothing to seize); working past what you can perceive; choosing exactly where the force goes — you decide WHEN, the mechanism decides where.

tree.name: Seized At Load

tree.cannot: MADE THINGS ONLY, and it must be UNDER LOAD — a mechanism at rest just stops, which is useful and is not this. You must perceive it. The force goes where the mechanism sends it, not where you want.

tree.cannot: A rival wright can feel this being done and answer it. And you have made everyone present distrust their own equipment, including your own — ANY ALLY RELYING ON A SEIZED MECHANISM IS STRUCK ONE RUNG LOWER.
